第 4 部分

双方主张

乘客方主张

主张 1

POL-NS-23 sets two limbs for a valid no-show cancellation: the driver must have sent at least one in-app chat message to the rider AND placed at least one in-app call to the rider, both before trip_record.cancelled_at. The trip record's in_app_calls array holds exactly one call, and it was placed BY THE RIDER at 18:38:40 for 35 s (placed_by: RIDER); the driver placed none. The chat log holds only two entries, both messages from the driver. The call limb of the obligation therefore fails, the platform's own derived contact_before_cancel.obligation_met is false, and the fee is voided: the rider is not charged, with no driver compensation.

证据编号: EV-TRIP-05063, EV-CHAT-05063

条款编号: POL-NS-23

代码核查结论: 保留 (KEPT)

主张 2

The driver's own account is that 'I called the passenger.' The platform's call ledger contradicts him on the decisive fact: zero calls were placed by the driver, and the single call on this trip was placed by the rider. A driver cannot discharge POL-NS-23's call limb with a call he did not make, and his assertion of that fact cannot be accepted against the record that was generated by the same platform.

证据编号: EV-TRIP-05063

条款编号: POL-NS-23

代码核查结论: 保留 (KEPT)

主张 3

The rider's account — that she called the driver to say she needed 5 more minutes because she was finishing a work call — is corroborated by the trip record: an in-app call placed by the rider at 18:38:40, answered, duration 35 s. She was in contact with the driver; the only party who failed to make contact by the means POL-NS-23 requires is the driver, who never rang her.

证据编号: EV-TRIP-05063, EV-CHAT-05063

条款编号: POL-NS-23

代码核查结论: 保留 (KEPT)

主张 4

Even on the driver's best reading — that the free wait under POL-NS-21 was observed, which the record does support (arrival 18:36:50, free wait ending 18:41:50, cancellation 18:43:20) — POL-NS-22's transfer of the 5.00 SGD to the driver does not follow. POL-NS-23 imposes a second, independent condition on the same cancellation, and a cancellation that clears the clock but breaches the contact obligation cannot found a no-show fee or driver compensation.

证据编号: EV-TRIP-05063, EV-FARE-05063

条款编号: POL-NS-21, POL-NS-22, POL-NS-23

代码核查结论: 保留 (KEPT)

主张 5

Read the outcome off the record: the driver filed (filed_by DRIVER), and the payments ledger already shows the 5.00 SGD refunded to the rider and withheld from the driver (refund_issued_sgd 5.00, payment_status REFUNDED). The driver's claim — that the 5.00 should stand with him — therefore fails, and POL-GEN-03 directs that the filing party's unsupported claim leaves the present state standing: NO_ACTION with both amount fields null. POL-NS-23's word for the remedy is 'FULL_REFUND', but POL-GEN-03 defines FULL_REFUND against the FILER; with the driver as filer that label would hand him the money. The substance of POL-NS-23 — that the rider is not charged — is satisfied by NO_ACTION, which locks in the reversal already on the ledger and leaves the rider carrying nothing.

证据编号: EV-FARE-05063

条款编号: POL-GEN-03, POL-NS-23

代码核查结论: 保留 (KEPT)

主张 6

No escalation is warranted and none is needed: the contested amount is 5.00 SGD, below POL-GEN-22's 10.00 SGD band, and neither party's profile carries a fraud flag (both are 0), so the AI ruling is final at any confidence. POL-NS-26 says the same for a no-show at this value. The case can be decided on this record, and the record decides it for the rider.

证据编号: EV-FARE-05063, EV-RPROF-05063, EV-DPROF-05063

条款编号: POL-GEN-22, POL-NS-26

代码核查结论: 保留 (KEPT)

司机方主张

主张 1

The driver's right to cancel for no-show is made out on this record: the GPS trace and trip record fix arrival at the pickup at 18:36:50, the 300-second free wait under POL-NS-21 expired at 18:41:50, and the driver cancelled at 18:43:20 — 390 seconds after arrival and 90 seconds past the free wait. The rider's 'he cancelled anyway' is not borne out by the clock: her call came at 18:38:40 and the driver waited a further 4 minutes 40 seconds, and no clause obliges him to extend the free wait because she asked for five more minutes.

证据编号: EV-TRIP-05063, EV-GPS-05063, EV-CHAT-05063

条款编号: POL-NS-21

代码核查结论: 保留 (KEPT)

主张 2

The amount on the record is exactly the fee POL-NS-22 fixes: the ledger shows a 5.00 SGD cancellation fee and fee_matches_policy true, and POL-NS-22 provides that where the driver cancels after the free wait and the fee stands the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd and driver_compensation_sgd both equal to the 5.00 SGD charged. The driver is the filer and the present state is a completed refund, so under POL-GEN-03 the only value that answers his claim is DRIVER_COMPENSATION of 5.00 SGD.

证据编号: EV-FARE-05063, EV-TRIP-05063

条款编号: POL-NS-22, POL-GEN-03

代码核查结论: 保留 (KEPT)

主张 3

POL-NS-23's contact requirement is answered on this record: the driver sent two in-app messages before cancelling (18:37:10 and 18:41:30) and the parties were in live, answered in-app voice contact for 35 seconds at 18:38:40, so the rider had actual notice and confirms it in her own statement. I do not put the driver's 'I called the passenger' above the platform record: the record's only in-app call is attributed to the rider, and the derived contact check returns call_count 0 and obligation_met false, so I do not assert the driver personally placed the call. The driver's case is that a live, answered, pre-cancellation in-app call in trip_record.in_app_calls, read together with the two messages, meets POL-NS-23's contact requirement, and that voiding the fee of a rider who knew the driver had arrived and chose to stay away would defeat the purpose of the clause.

证据编号: EV-CHAT-05063, EV-TRIP-05063

条款编号: POL-NS-23

代码核查结论: 保留 (KEPT)

主张 4

POL-NS-24 gives the rider nothing here. It is the clause for a driver who fails to arrive; the record shows the driver arrived at 18:36:50, that the GPS trace corroborates the arrival (nearest fix 3.3 m from the pickup, well inside the 50 m STANDARD radius under POL-NS-21), and that he held position at the pickup until cancellation. There was no driver no-show, so POL-NS-24 provides no route to a refund of the fee.

证据编号: EV-TRIP-05063, EV-GPS-05063

条款编号: POL-NS-24, POL-NS-21

代码核查结论: 保留 (KEPT)

主张 5

Nothing in POL-GEN-22 or POL-NS-26 sends this case to a human. Both profiles carry fraud_flags 0, and the amount contested is 5.00 SGD, below POL-GEN-22's 10.00 SGD band, so the AI ruling is final at any confidence and POL-NS-26's finality rule governs this no-show; the merits, not an escalation, should decide it.

证据编号: EV-RPROF-05063, EV-DPROF-05063, EV-FARE-05063

条款编号: POL-GEN-22, POL-NS-26

代码核查结论: 保留 (KEPT)

主张 6

The absent traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-05063-01, MISSING, weight 0.0 under POL-GEN-02) carries no fact and no weight, and traffic is not an element of a no-show charge, which POL-NS-21 measures by arrival and waiting time alone. Its absence cannot be turned into a failure of proof on the driver's side, and POL-GEN-26 is not engaged because no no-show rule depends on traffic data.

证据编号: EV-ADVIS-05063-01, EV-TRIP-05063

条款编号: POL-GEN-02, POL-NS-21

第 6 部分

裁决说明

Both of you agree on the timeline, and it is the timeline the record shows: the driver arrived at the pickup at 18:36:50 (the GPS trace corroborates the arrival, nearest fix 3.3 m away, well inside the 50 m STANDARD radius), the 300-second free wait under POL-NS-21 expired at 18:41:50, and the driver cancelled at 18:43:20. So the clock the driver relies on did run out, and his POL-NS-21 point is accepted.

But POL-NS-21's clock is not the only condition. POL-NS-23 makes a no-show charge valid only if the driver both sent at least one in-app chat message AND placed at least one in-app call to the rider before cancelling. The message limb is met: the chat log shows two driver messages, at 18:37:10 and 18:41:30. The call limb is not met. The trip record's in_app_calls array holds exactly one call, placed BY THE RIDER at 18:38:40 for 35 seconds, and the platform's own derived contact check returns call_count 0 and obligation_met false. A call the driver did not make cannot discharge POL-NS-23, and the driver's account that he 'called the passenger' is contradicted by the platform's own call ledger. The fee is therefore voided under POL-NS-23, and no driver compensation is payable.

Because the driver is the party who filed and the 5.00 SGD has already been refunded to the rider and recovered from the driver (fee_reversed at 22:55:20), POL-GEN-03 makes the outcome NO_ACTION: the rider keeps the 5.00 SGD, the driver's claim fails, and both amount fields are null. This is deliberately not FULL_REFUND, which POL-GEN-03 defines against the filer and which would hand the money back to the driver.

The driver's other points do not change this. POL-NS-24 does not apply — the driver arrived and held position, so there was no driver no-show and no goodwill credit. POL-NS-22's fee is exactly the 5.00 SGD the policy fixes, so its fee-amount referral does not fire (it triggers only on an amount other than 5.00 SGD). POL-NS-25's repeat counter is not present on the rider profile and is in any case zero, so no repeat no-show flag arises. The absent traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-05063-01, weight 0.0) carries no fact, and traffic is not an element of a no-show in any event.

No escalation is warranted: the amount contested is 5.00 SGD, below POL-GEN-22's 10.00 SGD band, and both profiles carry fraud_flags 0, so POL-NS-26 makes the AI ruling final. My confidence is 0.95, within the 1.0 cap set by the weight-1.0 trip record that carries the deciding fact.

法官就同样的材料被问了 4 次，每份草稿都同意这个裁决，因此一致通过（投票一致度 1.00）。
